description: A registered runtime value accessor. Core and extensions register these for mapped runtime object properties (see propertyTypes.runtime.valueAccessor). Retrieve and query this object type to discover accessors and their lifetime contracts before reusing or adding one.

brief.description: Short description of this accessor suitable for lists and completion.
brief.label: Brief

copiesUnderLock.brief: Result is copied under a lock
copiesUnderLock.description: When true, the accessor takes a lock (or equivalent) and copies data into the caller's pool so the result is stable after the call. Prefer this style for mutable env state shared across threads.
copiesUnderLock.label: Copies Under Lock

description.description: Description of what this accessor does, including expected internal shape, locking, and whether the Adaptive value aliases live state.
description.label: Description

key.description: Key of this entry in registry type runtime_value_accessor. Use this string as propertyTypes.runtime.valueAccessor on mapped object types.
key.label: Key

returnsLiveReference.brief: Result may alias live runtime state
returnsLiveReference.description: When true, the returned Adaptive value may point into live environment or instance state that can change or be released while the value is still held. Callers must not assume a snapshot unless copiesUnderLock is also true.
returnsLiveReference.label: Returns Live Reference
